portfolio.shorting: DEFENSIVE only when permitted by regime policy

decision.execution: next session open after close-t decision
decision.exit_to_safe: incumbent fails absolute qualification or regime permission
decision.replace: eligible challenger score exceeds incumbent score by replacement margin

causal_score_search.purpose: DEV50 nested selection only; no preserved50/Test17

outcome_definition.daily_learning_target: next-session open-to-next-session-open return / contemporaneous SAFE excess, not 3/5/10/20/63-day future return
outcome_definition.reason: prevent fixed holding horizon from being moved upstream into the score
outcome_definition.historical_candidate_horizon_labels: may define fixed-horizon CONTROL only; prohibited as challenger quality labels

friction.stock_etf_execution_model: 5 bps one-way conservative spread/slippage proxy for first pass; report zero-friction sensitivity separately
friction.regulatory_fees: report limitation separately; do not represent as Webull commission
friction.short_borrow: report separately; no production claim without borrow treatment

validation.selection: train on 4 folds, choose one deterministic Pareto/knee policy without outer-fold outcomes, replay heldout fold once

regime.current_DEV50_allocator_test: allocator mechanics may be developed on consumed DEV50; incomplete Path-A/R1 blocks preserved50 integrated replay
regime.defensive_activity_limit: must remain active whenever causal market-state tape says DEFENSIVE; allocator cannot restore NORMAL exposure
